newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks creep higher in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks creep higher in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks crept higher in early morning trade on Monday, led buy small-lot buying in blue-chips, brokers said. They said the gains, although small, were expected as books for the first half of the fiscal year close on Monday and firms may do some last-minute cross trades.
At 0019 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was up 39.82 points or 0.18 percent at 21,586.84. Its December futures were up 90 points at 21,590.
"The Nikkei average rose throughout the week last week and there are some technical signs indicating that further, large gains may be difficult," one broker said.
